dialect.detail: PC-based COBOL for XT/AT, likely Micro Focus Personal COBOL or compatible; uses COMP-4, ACCEPT/DISPLAY with LINE/POSITION clauses, REVERSE attribute, screen-oriented I/O typical of Micro Focus on DOS/PC
evidence: ACCEPT ... LINE ... POSITION ... ON EXCEPTION EXCEP

purpose.domain_detail: Inventory/stock management system for articles (products) with partidas (lots/batches), pricing, costs, internal taxes, and stock quantities; likely for a retail or wholesale business in Argentina (Spanish language, peso-style numeric formatting)
purpose.summary: This program manages article partidas (stock lots/batches) including alta (add), baja (delete), and modification of records. It handles pricing (sale price, cost price, internal tax), stock balances, pending deliveries, kilo tracking, and warehouse position data, with screen-based interactive input and printed reports.

notable_features: DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA (European/Latin American numeric format)
COMP-4 binary fields used for display control parameters
Heavy use of COPY statements (36 copybooks) for file SELECT, FD, error handling
DECLARATIVES section with error handlers via COPY
Signed numeric fields with S9(6)V999 for stock quantities
BLANK WHEN ZERO and picture editing with comma decimal separator
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: Source truncated to first 16000 chars; full program is 1111 lines. Spanish-language variable names and labels suggest Argentine origin (author Alvaro Guiffrey, date Jul 1990). The program_type is classified as online-cics loosely — it is actually a screen-based interactive batch program on PC, not CICS; no better enum fits. COPY statements reference external copybooks not shown. Encoding is latin-1 which is consistent with Spanish text.
